source.notes: 2026-10-01 按封面调研新增：学习成熟的封面做法（类型与渲染拆分、单一强焦点、标题与画面呼应），自行撰写配方；基础可调用版，尚未通过准入。

essence: 深色底，左侧自上而下：品牌名一行小字、系列标签（圆角色块）、超大粗衬线主标题
右侧一个认得出的主体（可多件叠放）加一轮暖色圆日与剪影
只用一个暖色强调（橙红）加米金细线，其余深色

recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): a premium dark series cover for articles in a numbered series. Deep aubergine-black canvas (#1B1624). Left side top to bottom: a small brand line with a thin underline, a rounded tag chip in warm orange-red (#E8704E) carrying the series name, then a very large bold serif headline in warm off-white (#F5EDE0) on one or two lines, and a thin champagne-gold rule beneath. Right side: one clearly recognisable hero subject (several overlapping items allowed) with a large flat warm-coloured sun disc and a dark silhouette skyline or landscape behind it, flat graphic shapes with fine paper grain; cinematic, calm and premium; no neon, no glow, no gradient starfield, no frames or boxes around the headline.

must_see: 深色底、左侧品牌名加系列标签加超大主标题
右侧一个认得出的主体加暖色圆日与剪影
只有一个暖色强调加米金细线
